doc: Packages a staging slot may carry (studio/stage/make-slot.py, tools/check_stage_slot.py). com.gamecore.* packages come from the source project's manifest by absolute file: path to the source repository's Packages/ directory, except the denied ones below (Studio packages never enter a slot; the qualification marker packages compile qualification code in). com.unity.* packages must be listed here by name and carry exactly the source project's pin. The candidate package is embedded under Packages/<name> and is not a manifest dependency.

scanExemptions.header: // Generated by GameCore.Content.Compiler.CatalogEmitter; do not edit by hand.
scanExemptions.reason: A mechanism's own catalog is emitted by the repository's CatalogEmitter (tools/emit_generated_catalog.py), the same emitter that writes every gameplay package's generated catalog. The emitter writes its registration, key, schema and serializer tables as `static readonly T[]` because the kernel catalog contract consumes arrays, and nothing writes them after type initialisation. The exemption covers only `static readonly` lines in `Generated/*.g.cs` files that carry the emitter's header. A non-readonly static, a static event or `[ThreadStatic]` in the same file still fails the scan, and so does any hand-written file. The determinism step (two fresh smoke runs with equal slot hashes) still guards against shared state. stage_real found the need on the W-MECH-01 pressure plate: 14 hits, all of them emitter tables.
